Charlotte Bike Party

Charlotte, NC · Optimist Park · Social

No-dropBeginner friendly

Charlotte Bike Party is a social group ride in Charlotte, NC. It rolls second Friday of the month at 7:00 pm from Birdsong Brewing. About under 10 miles, easy pace, flat route. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: easy pace, flat route. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @cltbikeparty the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Charlotte Bike Party group ride

A monthly ride that leaves from Birdsong Brewing. The route is flat, simple and under 10 miles. No one gets dropped. All bikes and all riders are welcome.
